dedupe_keys.name: ev charging session data at nyc municipal lots and garages plugnyc nyc open data

description: Session-level records of electric vehicle charging at the public chargers that New York City installed in municipal parking lots and garages under its PlugNYC programme, published by the Department of Transportation on NYC Open Data. Each row is one session with the date, station name, location name, charge box and connector identifiers, connection and disconnection times, charge duration and connected duration in minutes, energy provided in kWh, session status and an invalidity reason. Coverage: 26 locations and 166 stations, with 258,755 sessions from July 2021 to 8 September 2026 when read; the busiest garage is the Queens Borough Hall municipal garage. Format and access: free CSV, JSON or Socrata API; the page lists the update frequency as daily but states no licence. Caveats: the table carries driver and ID tag fields whose content was not checked, and the page gives no data dictionary for session status values. Useful as input to simulation of charging demand, load shapes and capacity planning for chargers as flexible loads in public parking space; related records are not yet linked.
